description: M2-10: trust core on real MEG decoder output. Synchronous keystroke decoder with oracle key timing (Brain2Qwerty v1 setting), not a real-time device setting.
train_trials: split == 'train' and not is_training; labels = key_chars (what was typed); keys other than a-z and space dropped
eval_trials: split in (val, test) and not is_training
harness: TrustPipeline.fit(val, val): frame T (before the beam), sentence T, conformal and policy thresholds all on val; report on test. Truth = target_text. Decoder = RETUNED beam, lm_weight picked on val on frame-calibrated streams, n_best=10.
